## About
Akshay Kumar Bolusani is an AI & Full-Stack Software Engineer based in Hyderabad, India. Founder of ProjectKaro (Jan 2024 – present), a software studio that has delivered 60+ projects with a team of 23. Former Web Development Intern at Digital Connect (Aug 2023 – Jan 2026), where he built and maintained 100+ client websites. B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering, Malla Reddy University (2022–2026, CGPA 8.97). Presented a research paper at PiCET 2026 (Scopus-indexed IET proceedings). Former Vice President, Dept. of CSE (700+ students). Founder of Gopyata (https://gopyata.in), DPDP privacy-readiness for Indian businesses.

## Notable Projects
- Shapeshift: free, open-source, offline file converter for macOS (Swift, MIT). Drag a file, tap a key, drop it on a wedge. https://github.com/AkshayKumarBolusani/shapeshift
- Cognora AI: local-first retrieval-augmented document Q&A with per-page citations (Ollama, Qdrant, SQLite, FastAPI, React, PDF.js)
- India Invoice AI: open-source (MIT), review-first GST invoice intelligence with Decimal arithmetic checks
- SkinCare AI: skin disease detection with fine-tuned DINOv2 and ResNet50 served via FastAPI
- Enterprise SOC Lab: Wazuh, Elastic Stack and Suricata mapped to MITRE ATT&CK
